scenarios.description: LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl returns Flowable.empty() when subAgents is null.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl repeats subAgent events Integer.MAX_VALUE times when maxIterations is not set.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl propagates errors if subAgent.runAsync throws an exception during iteration.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl handles maxIterations set to 0 (ensure loop handles zero correctly and does not repeat).
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl completes normally when no events have escalate action and iteration reaches maxIterations.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl handles scenario where all subAgents' runAsync throw exceptions (robustness under total failure).
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl handles subAgents() returning a list containing null elements (i.e., subAgent list with null agent[s]).

LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl correctly applies beforeAgentCallback and afterAgentCallback for each iteration and each sub-agent, ensuring both callbacks are invoked even if sub-agent returns error, empty, or escalate action.

LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl properly stops iteration when hasEscalateAction returns true in any event from any subAgent, not just the first, during any iteration, ensuring escalation short-circuits further looping regardless of subAgent order or iteration count.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl returns events from subAgents when maxIterations is set to 0 (should not repeat, only one pass).
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl handles maxIterations set to Integer.MIN_VALUE without throwing and with correct iteration behavior.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl handles subAgent.runAsync returning null Flowable gracefully (null handling).
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl handles subAgent.runAsync returning an empty Flowable (no events emitted).
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl propagates errors if subAgent.runAsync throws a checked exception.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl processes events correctly when hasEscalateAction returns true for the first event in first iteration.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl processes events correctly when hasEscalateAction only returns true in the last event of last iteration.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl keeps iteration in sync with maxIterations when maxIterations is set to an arbitrary positive value.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl works when beforeAgentCallback and afterAgentCallback are set, exercising callbacks side effects if any.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl skips iteration and returns empty when all subAgents return empty streams.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl continues all subAgents and iterations when hasEscalateAction always returns false, even if some subAgents emit multiple events per iteration.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl processes events correctly if subAgent.runAsync emits multiple events and escalate occurs after the first event within the same subAgent invocation.
